summary:
## Idea
Game.Core Fov computes visible grid cells around an origin using its shadowcasting implementation; the transparency predicate is caller-owned.

## Complexity
An unobstructed radius-r neighbourhood contains O(r²) cells; work depends on scanned sectors and transparency calls. The result stores the visible-cell set.

## Use when
A .NET grid game needs area field of view rather than separate per-target rays.

## Avoid when
Supported JavaScript source-view use or a continuous visibility polygon is required.

## Pitfalls
FOV and pairwise LOS need not share every boundary convention. Current compatibility profile explicitly grades Fov DotNetOnly; integer code alone is not Fable evidence.

## F# usage
Package: FS.GG.Game.Core; cited source API (resolve your actual package pin).
`FS.GG.Game.Core.Fov.fov: (Cell -> bool) -> Cell -> int -> Set<Cell>`

```fsharp
open FS.GG.Game.Core
let visible (origin: Cell) = Fov.fov (fun _ -> true) origin 8
```

## Tests
FovTests is the cited existing visibility/property suite. Its current DotNetOnly grade and missing Fable qualification are preserved.

## Bench
Owed: technique-specific timing baseline under https://github.com/FS-GG/FS.GG.Game/issues/804. No timing or cross-runtime performance claim is made here.
